name: Sindhri Sweet Mangoes
shortDesc: The undisputed Queen of Mangoes from Mirpurkhas and Hyderabad. Incredibly fragrant, silky smooth texture, and heavenly sweetness.
healthBenefits: Packed with Vitamins A & C, digestive enzymes, and essential dietary fiber for summer energy.
storageTip: Leave at room temperature until fragrant and slightly soft to touch; refrigerate only once fully ripe.

name: Farm Fresh Red Tomatoes
shortDesc: Vine-ripened, juicy red tomatoes harvested daily from Thatta, Badin, and Malir farms.
healthBenefits: High in Lycopene, Vitamin C, and Potassium for heart health and immunity.
storageTip: Store stem-side down at room temperature in a breathable basket; avoid refrigeration before cutting.

name: Desi Organic Spinach (Palak)
shortDesc: Tender, small-leaf desi spinach picked at dawn from the Malir green belt. Naturally rich in iron and chlorophyll.
healthBenefits: Loaded with iron, folate, Vitamin K, and antioxidants for strong blood circulation.
storageTip: Do not wash until ready to cook. Keep wrapped in a damp muslin cloth in the crisper.

name: Swat Golden Crisp Apples
shortDesc: Crisp, sweet, and aromatic apples hand-plucked from the mountain orchards of Kalam and Mingora, Swat Valley.
healthBenefits: Rich in pectin dietary fiber, quercetin, and Vitamin C for lower cholesterol and gut health.
storageTip: Store in the refrigerator fruit drawer to preserve maximum juiciness and crunch for weeks.

name: Multani White Chaunsa Mangoes
shortDesc: Celebrated worldwide for its irresistible honeyed aroma and fiber-free pulp from Multan and Rahim Yar Khan.
healthBenefits: Excellent energy booster rich in bioactive polyphenols and Vitamin A.
storageTip: Ripen at room temperature wrapped in paper; chill in ice water for an hour before eating.

name: Crisp Green Okra (Bhindi)
shortDesc: Tender, slender green okra pods freshly harvested without hard seeds. Ideal for crispy fried bhindi.
healthBenefits: Contains soluble mucilage fiber that balances blood sugar and aids smooth digestion.
storageTip: Store completely dry in a paper bag in the vegetable compartment; wash and dry completely before cutting.

name: Spicy Malir Green Chillies
shortDesc: Zesty, pungent, and intensely flavorful chillies cultivated along the Malir riverbed for authentic Pakistani handi.
healthBenefits: Rich in Capsaicin which fires up metabolism, burns calories, and relieves sinus congestion.
storageTip: Remove green stems before storing in an airtight glass container with a dry tissue paper.

name: Sweet Larkana Guavas (Amrood)
shortDesc: Soft white and pink flesh guavas bursting with fragrance, picked straight from Sindh's Larkana orchards.
healthBenefits: Contains 4x more Vitamin C than oranges; loaded with roughage fiber for digestion.
storageTip: Ripens fast at room temperature; sprinkle with chaat masala when freshly sliced.

name: Sargodha Juicy Kinnow Oranges
shortDesc: Super juicy, sun-kissed citrus from Punjab's world-famous citrus heartland, Sargodha.
healthBenefits: Exceptional immune booster packed with bioflavonoids, potassium, and active Vitamin C.
storageTip: Keeps well at cool room temperature for up to 10 days, or refrigerated for up to 3 weeks.

name: Pure Farm Desi Makhan & Ghee
shortDesc: Traditional Bilona method clarified butter churned from pure grass-fed buffalo milk in Sindh & Punjab dairy farms.
healthBenefits: Rich in healthy short-chain fatty acids (Butyrate), Vitamins A, D, E, and K2 for joint vitality.
storageTip: Keep in an airtight stainless steel or glass jar away from direct moisture; does not require refrigeration.

name: Organic Desi Free-Range Farm Eggs
shortDesc: Golden-yolk farm eggs from naturally pasture-roaming desi Aseel chickens fed organic grains and greens.
healthBenefits: Superior Omega-3 fats, bioavailable choline for brain power, and complete high-quality protein.
storageTip: Store pointy-end down in refrigerator egg shelf; use within 3 weeks of purchase.

name: Margalla Wild Berry Raw Honey
shortDesc: 100% raw unheated berry (sidr / beri) honey collected by local beekeepers in the hills of Margalla and Karak.
healthBenefits: Natural antimicrobial, soothes coughs and boosts natural immunity.
storageTip: Keep sealed at room temperature. Natural crystallization is proof of purity—warm gently to liquefy.

name: Swat Valley Sweet Strawberries
shortDesc: Pesticide-free ruby red strawberries cultivated with glacial stream water in the alpine valleys of KPK.
healthBenefits: High in Vitamin C, flavonoids, and manganese with very low glycemic index.
storageTip: Store unwashed with stem on in a paper-lined container in the fridge; wash right before eating.

name: Hydroponic Organic Tuscan Kale
shortDesc: Dark leafy dinosaur kale grown in nutrient-dense hydroponic systems in Karachi and Lahore farmsteads.
healthBenefits: Superfood rich in Vitamin K, calcium, lutein, and detoxifying glucosinolates.
storageTip: Trim stems and place in a glass of water like flowers in the fridge, or wrap in a damp cloth.

name: Stoneground Desi Wheat & Sourdough
shortDesc: Slow-fermented artisan sourdough crafted with indigenous Pakistani Chakki Atta and wild yeast starter.
healthBenefits: Long fermentation breaks down gluten and phytic acid, making it gut-friendly and nutrient-dense.
storageTip: Keep cut side down on a wooden cutting board or in a linen bread bag; freeze sliced for longevity.
